questions.stem: Why does salivary amylase stop working when food reaches the stomach?

options.text: All the starch has already been digested
The acidic pH in the stomach denatures the amylase
Amylase is absorbed into the blood in the stomach
The stomach is too cold for amylase to work

questions.explanation: Salivary amylase works best at a neutral pH (around 7). The highly acidic conditions in the stomach (pH 2) denature the amylase, changing the shape of its active site so it can no longer function.
